ms.report:
New Proof of Achievement for Milestone 3

A. Output: Green Orders validator integration and deployed validator references

Acceptance criteria: The Green Orders codebase includes the validator-facing data model and preprod deployment references required to execute Green Orders against Royalty V1 pools. The delivered code includes Aiken-compatible intention encoding, Aleph account validator integration, batch witness integration, and Royalty V1 pool validator references used by the off-chain agent and the demo scripts.

Evidence:
- Green Order / Aleph intention model and Aiken-compatible CBOR encoding: https://github.com/splashprotocol/green-order-offchain-agent/blob/green-order-agent-bootstrap/bloom-offchain-cardano/src/orders/green.rs
- Deployed preprod validator references for `royaltyPoolLedgerFixed`, `alephAccount`, and `alephBatchWitness`: https://github.com/splashprotocol/green-order-offchain-agent/blob/green-order-agent-bootstrap/green-order-cardano-agent/resources/preprod.deployment.json
- Deployment loader that wires the Royalty V1 pool and Aleph validators into the agent runtime: https://github.com/splashprotocol/green-order-offchain-agent/blob/green-order-agent-bootstrap/green-order-cardano-agent/src/deployment.rs

B. Output: Rust off-chain Green Orders agent

Acceptance criteria: The Rust off-chain agent accepts signed Green Order intents, binds observed Aleph accounts, indexes account state, plans full-fill and partial-fill execution, tracks Merkle Patricia Forest account-store transitions, and executes orders against Royalty V1 pools. The implementation is available through the public milestone branch.

Evidence:
- Agent entry point and execution wiring: https://github.com/splashprotocol/green-order-offchain-agent/blob/green-order-agent-bootstrap/green-order-cardano-agent/src/main.rs
- HTTP intent ingestion, validation, and admission API: https://github.com/splashprotocol/green-order-offchain-agent/blob/green-order-agent-bootstrap/green-order-cardano-a

New Proof of Achievement for Milestone 4

Milestone title: SDK development

Milestone Output 1 — SDK codebase with necessary functionalities for integration

Description: The delivered TypeScript SDK is the developer-facing integration layer for Green Orders. It provides helpers to build wire-compatible Green Order intent payloads, compute the Aleph-compatible intention digest, sign intents through an injected wallet/signer, submit signed intents to a Green Order agent, bind Aleph accounts, query account status, fetch account summaries, query readiness, and monitor the agent. The milestone branch also includes the Green Order agent HTTP routes required by the SDK, including submit, bind, account status, account summary, and monitoring endpoints.
